verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents EU regional email sending through a dedicated EU API base URL (api.eu.sendgrid.com) for EU regional subusers, so users can choose an EU region. This is gated to the Pro plan or above, and the docs frame it as regional sending rather than explicitly as data-at-rest residency. missing for 10: explicit statement that data is stored in the chosen region, region options beyond the EU/default, availability on lower plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.
